en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing the interior of a simple Protestant-style church. The image looks toward the altar at the far end of a long nave with wooden pews on both sides, arched windows, a pulpit on the left, and a central altar with a large framed painting or altarpiece above it. Printed caption text appears below the image indicating the place and publisher details.
